units.source_text: ……寺庙众僧手待"无门关"讲义，聚在昏暗的灯光下。

en.t: ...The monks of the temple gathered under the dim light, holding their lecture notes on The Gateless Gate.

units.source_text: 夜间寒冷，老师身旁只放着一只小手炉。

en.t: The night was cold, and beside the teacher there was only a small hand warmer.

units.source_text: 可以听见抽鼻涕的声音。

en.t: The sound of people sniffling could be heard.

units.source_text: 低着头的老老少少的脸被影子画成了花脸，每张脸上都露出了难以形容的有气无力的神情。

en.t: The bowed faces of old and young alike were painted into mottled masks by the shadows, and on every face there appeared an indescribable look of listlessness.

units.source_text: 新进庙的弟子，白天任小学教师，他的近视眼镜不时地从瘦削的鼻梁上滑落下来。

en.t: The novice temple disciple, who worked as an elementary school teacher during the day, had nearsighted glasses that kept slipping down from the bridge of his thin nose.
